Thank you for the 5-star review, Tadhg!

I have brought all my 5 cats here to village vets and they have been fabulous. After a terrible experience at a previous vet, they have made our experience a very happy one. I would reccomend anyone to bring their animals here. They are so professional,kind and caring. You can see that they really love their jobs.

Hello Avin,
Thank you very much for taking the time to review our page and leave us these 5 stars.
We really appreciate them.

Kind regards
Village Vets Beaumont

I would like to acknowledge the wonderful beautiful compassionate,sensitive and caring services which we have just received on the passing of our beautiful Ruby.  It was sudden and out of the blue,they were fantastic from start to finish. They had Ruby laid out with great kindness and sensitivity in a beautiful room,.you made this very very emotional sad experience very respectful 🙏 thank you for minding our Ruby it was very very much appreciated. Also for my Ruby's print Paws and some hair along with a beautiful card with lovely kind words. It meant so much to us at this very sad time. Thank you all❤️

My dog Hughie loves visiting,he always gets a warm welcome.He has been through an illness recently and between village vets beaumont and UCD Veterinary hospital,hes had the best care.They have been brilliant with him.well deserved 5* 💟 …

Teddy our dog can be temperamental especially when he is not well. Both Rory and Paola who have cared for him are so gentle, kind, knowledgeable and experienced. I wouldn't consider going to any other surgery. The girls on the front desk are always so friendly and helpful.
Last visit with Cher was really her last  visit.she died

For the first time, the visit was not good! I took my daughter to get her nails cut, trusting that they wouldn't hurt her, and when we got to the car she was bleeding, meaning they had hurt her. Knowing my daughter, I'm sure she screamed, and at no point was it mentioned that she had been hurt; it was only noticed because she was bleeding! We returned, and then they stopped the bleeding.
Gud Verification
Thank you so much for the five stars! It means a lot!

Couldn't recommend this place more - everyone here is an absolute star. Our two cats Sylvie and Sadhbh have both had minor health issues and are looked after so well. On top of that everyone is just so kind, and so proactive with your pet's health whether it's routine or otherwise. I leave here feeling great every time. Really appreciate all the folks here!
Excellent!very accomodating and caring. The pet plan is great value. Highly recommend!
Excellent service as always,Bonnie is so well looked after.

Have been bringing my dog Alfie here for years. Luckily for nothing more serious than his annual check ups but even then the staff have been very attentive, extremely polite and very helpful whenever I have had any queries for them. Cannot recommend these vets any higher and their passion for the animals that come to them is clear to see. Your pet is in great hands here.

Paula is so patient and kind to our dog and all the staff so wonderful and helpful!
Raheny Village Vets fantastic to deal with.

I'm so grateful to all the staff at the Village Vets Beaumont. They have been so good to my cat Mash and me, they are always available to patiently answer and explain any of my concerns. Mash had a procedure done recently and they were so attentive and caring, even in days after, texting me to check in on how he was healing. When he had an allergic reaction to the flea treatment, they took the the time to research and found another kind that works for him. They really care about their animals, I can't recommend them enough. Thank you so much guys!
They’re very kind and so helpful. I’m doing paperwork for my dog to travel abroad and they know absolutely everything. I would definitely recommend this place.

Hello Ruth,
Thank you for taking the time to review our page and leave us these 5 stars, we really appreciate them.

Kind regards
Village Vets Beaumont
As always, very happy with the friendly & helpful service from Village Vets, Beaumont.

My dog Jax is getting on in years so going to the vets is becoming a bit more regular so it’s great that he seems to like coming into this vets and gets his treats at the desk. Staff are lovely with him and remember his name. Great service and getting an appointment is easy enough usually.

Our dogs are always well looked after, regardless of the reason for our visit.  All staff members are pleasant and kind.  We never feel rushed and know that our concerns and questions are being heard.
Rory gave Rocky a very good check over this morning and reassured me about his overall health.   Many many thanks.
Very good

Village vets are very efficient in contacting customers about due dates for vaccines etc.
The vets are very helpful and caring with pets.
Very friendly staff. Always sending reminders for pets medication. Lovely clean reception and always available with advice for pets diet and wellbeing. They make owners and pets feel at ease.

Could not recommend Village Vets Beaumont enough!
My dog has always been so extremely anxious at other vet clinics, often leaving appointments absolutely rattled for the rest of the day. Today, however, the veterinarian was SO, so patient and gentle with him that Loki left jumping around and wagging his tail!

All of our concerns were immediately put to rest, unlike visits to other vets that left us feeling more worried than before we arrived. We can already see that Loki feels so much better, which is such a huge relief!

The receptionist was also so incredibly kind and welcoming☺️Couldn’t thank them enough!

We had to attend Ashbourne clinic last night as an emergency. Our dog Cas who was in heart failure for the last 3 months and kindly treated by village vet Clonsilla, took really bad and the staff in Ashbourne couldn’t have been nicer. Unfortunately we had to make the decision of euthanising her and the vet and nurses were so nice and understanding. Thank you for helping us on our way to accepting our little princess would not be coming home with us.

Village Vets Beaumont have been amazing, always happy staff, really helpful, caring and professional. They have been amazing with our Lady at such a difficult time. Abbey at the front desk is amazing, always smiling. They are also all very good artists 😂 …
Good. Fast.and efficient

always get great service at village vets
and scout lovrs the way he is yreated
bounces in and out

Genuinely cannot rate Village Vets Beaumont higher, they have always gone above and beyond for our dog and I've always felt the level of care and love the staff give their patients and their owners to be of the highest standard. They really care. A particular shout out to Sarah & Emilia, but everyone we've dealt with is lovely.
Thank you very much Noel for taking the time to review our page and leaving these 5 stars.

Have only had bad experiences with this place. Never have anything I’ve ordered for my dog on time. They do not care about the animals and I have had to go for a second opinion multiple times.  My dog is diabetic and they never had the insulin even after ordering 2 weeks in advance. Terrible experience do not recommend. AVOID
Service  was very good, friendly,  Thank you so much  all staff !👍🏻 …
Thanks very much Tom.

The team at village vets are so helpful and friendly. I’ve been to a few of their branches and all of them are wonderful. They are thorough and have followed up anytime I have been in with them to make sure my pet is still ok. Highly recommend
Had Coco down yesterday and as usual her treatment was very good

The Staffa is helpful in every respekt,so far
I have no complaints,and I have Beenhakker here for a long time - I recommend it
Super and caring!
The team are wonderful. The care my dog milo got when he was neutered was exceptional. Everyone is so friendly.
Fantastic vets. I had such a bad experience with my pet's former health plan and this one is more than perfect.
I find all the vets, nurses and all other staff extremely friendly and helpful especially Paula by whom my puppy Dillon would mainly be taken care of. Their health plan is also very good.
Great Fast friendly service as always would highly recommend

Staff at Village Vets took great care of our Millie when she was at risk of toxicity  following consuming raisins. They did everything possible and kept me updated and I'm happy to report she is well.  I was unhappy with the huge bill but was advised of it in advance of treatment and  inpatient care. Margaret.
Great place to get your pets looked after

I just want to thank the whole team for looking after Hugo today. The care he received was excellent, as always. I really appreciate the genuine love and attention they give to every pet, and their Pet Plan is a fantastic option for ongoing care.

Everyone is always friendly, incredibly efficient, and, refreshingly, there’s no upselling. They focus on the issue at hand, provide thorough treatment, and offer helpful advice without any pressure. From the reception desk to the treatment room, the team shows real knowledge, compassion, and experience.

Highly recommend!

We noticed some swelling on my dog's paw, and Village vets provided us with an appointment within 15 minutes and were able to provide us with solid advice.

Thank you team at Village Vets! We know Cody and Arlo are in good hands when we come to you.
What a gorgeous photo! Thank you for sharing :)
Paid our first visit to Village Vets in Beaumont on July 11th with our new rescue dog. I can't recommend this place enough. The staff were very welcoming, friendly and knowledgeable.
3rd visit for Bowie. Lovely vets....Bowie certainly likes them! Would recommend to any pet owners

Thank you so much for taking great care of Millie when she got spayed.She was very calm and loved all the attention she got at at Village Vets in Beaumont. Well recommend them for your furry friends
Maria Murphy
Hello Danuta, thank you so much for taking the time to review our page and for these 5 stars.
Thank you so much for your 5 star review.
Thank you so much for taking the time to leave these 5 stars.
I tried booking an appointment online to get my cat a pet passport; but I couldn't finish because my US phone number couldn't be used. Could you please share an email I could reach out to?
Thank you Sinead!
Thank you for the five star review! We appericate it.
Always a fantastic service
Very nice staff - a clean neat clinic - if you need a vet for your pet I personally recommended this place.
The exam room was clean. Staff friendly. Dr Joane Silva was very nice and patient, answered any questions or concerns I had. Would recommend this practice. So glad it is in my neighbourhood
Great vets. The advice was expert and straightforward. The overall experience was 10/10. Everybody were great. If you have a pet, this is a vet you should consider going to
Hello Leanne, thank you so much for taking the time to review our page. We really appreciate your 5 stars 😍 …

Very frustrating experience. Took the day off as I have loads to do. Booked vaccinations appointment for our dog. Arrived on time. And then... just left to sit there. Dog panting because he's nervous. Eventually I had to ask when the appointment would happen - told there is an emergency case they are dealing with. Which is fine, these things happen. But to be left sitting there with no communication is not the way to handle it. I could have been told that when I walked in. We all have things to do and I could have rearranged things. In the end, I left. No communication. No updates. No apology. No attempt to understand the impact this delay has on my day or my time. The receptionist had more interaction with the computer than with me. If the emergency case had taken 4 hours, I believe I would still be sitting there, none the wiser, no explanation. I found it incredibly disrespectful.
Love Beaumont Village Vets! Great vet and staff. Always really obliging with arranging visits, particularly for travel. Highly recommended. My bichon always happy to visit.
Great clinic! Highly recommend 👌🏽 …
Very friendly staff and pet care is brilliant
I am very happy with the doctors at Village Vets. They are very kind to the animals.
The staff are brilliant, recently moved from Ashbourne back to Dublin so it is great to see there is another village vets near me
Excellent service !!  Seen promptly. Good advice given Highly recommend

Rude staff, and not well organised. I was 10 min late for my appointment, was told the vet had moved on to the next one luckily there was a slot just after free for me. Ironically, there was a delay with the previous slot and so my new appointment started 10 minutes after the scheduled time. They expect punctuality from customers (as they should) but can’t offer the same in return. They mixed up my bill when I was leaving and then chased me for outstanding fees that I had not been made aware of.  Not great at confidentiality either as they shared out details of my pets outside of the named people in my brand new account. I also experienced a lot of issues and confusion when signing up to their pet plan which in the end worked out for the best as I would only be stuck with them for 12 months and I will be sure to go elsewhere in future. I will note the vet that I was dealing with herself was great, I only experienced issues with the nurses/reception.
My dog had pad on his paw which was red. They applied the cream for me twice a day as I was on the plan so didn’t have to pay for each visit. He wouldn’t let me near his foot.
Fantastic vets. All the staff are really lovely, and appointments always run on time. Very kind and caring with all my animals !
Great service look after my Bichon very well.
Thank you so much!
The young vet gave me lots of time and really listened to my queries. I was really happy with the service and also with the office/support staff who were helpful and unobtrusive.

From the moment you walk through the door, you are greeted with warmth and genuine care. The boys love visiting and it’s not hard to see why. It’s clear when you see the staff that they are driven by a love of animals and a commitment to providing them with the best care. It’s a testament to each and every member of staff how much the boys love visiting and always refuse to leave. They create a loving and comfortable environment for them, always showering them in love and cuddles.

What set them apart is their compassionate approach and their constant willingness to go above and beyond to provide the boys with the best care. They do not have  to provide the help and support they do but no matter what they are always there.

Photo speaks for itself - a 12 week old puppy this comfortable on his first visit to the vets. Staff just showered him in cuddles. Nine months on nothing has changed.

Thank you to everyone at Village Vets Beaumont for your constant support, help and exceptional care with the boys. The boys love you all so much.
Amazing service always. So pleasant staff, always ready to help out. Definitely recommend this clinic.

Been with Village Vets since 2020!

First with Kilmainham and since 2022 I’ve been with the amazing team out in Beaumont ☺️

The care and love they have for animals is so obvious ❤️ The vets, nurses and admin are all so lovely! My two little ones had excellent dental care and extractions recently (thank you Paola!). My two always get the best care there and I’ve always had the best experiences with Joana, Bernie and Paola. The pet plan is a godsend!!
Paula was so approachable with a genuine affection for my boy (Billie, cat) and great advice.  Was really nice too .I'd recommend Paula .

Village Vets has changed our lives. One of our dogs is absolutely terrified of the vets. He's really big and strong. He was treated quite badly at another vets a few years ago and can be really hard to manage. Bernie and Paula's patience,kindness and professionalism has brought him to a stage where he let them take out stitches on his stomach.  All staff are amazing there, have a no fear policy and from phone to vets ,all in between are amazing.  The policy is really affordable too and discounts that come with it.
Cannot recommend enough 🥰
Quality service for your pet,quick and reliable with knowledgeable staff.

I would like to give my review on the Village Vets Beaumont. The vet where amazing very good great listening to what I had to say. My dog Molly was very comfortable they were gentle with her. The receptiveness Alex was very polite good manners very well spoken. I would 100% recommend the Village Vets Beaumont. In all a great service with lovely people who work there.
We’ve always had a good experience for both our dogs. We are on the annual plan and appreciate being able to call in whenever we need to.

Dear Elizabeth we are sorry to hear about your negative experience with us, we always strive to provide the best care to our clients and patients, if you wish to discuss this further please do not hesitate to contact us on beaumont@villagevets.ie

The staff at Village Vets Beaumont are amazing. They care for our dogs as if they were their own. Thank you so much to each one of you.

Ágatha & Cido

My first appointment was yesterday with my dog and the service was excellent. Very caring and gentle with her as she is old and nervous. I signed up to the monthly plan which is great value and am delighted I've moved to this vet. I would highly recommend them on first impressions alone.
Amazing nurse and receptionist. Helped us so much with our 1st visit with our new pup. Signed up for the monthly plan.

With all my interactions with Village Vets I have never had a bad experience. Everyone is so nice and friendly and professional. My dog Harvey loves going here because they make a big deal of him.

I wouldn't chose any other Vet ever
Friendly, helpful and lovely staff!
Lovely staff. Very helpful.
€220 for a consultation and a blood test! Very expensive for a retiree.
Amazing care for my little puppy during her neutering … the team were so kind and concerned to make it as easy as possible .. for all of us !
First time attending Village Vers. Very thorough and friendly service -

All the staff at Village Vets Beaumont are very friendly and so patient with my dogs.

Thanks so much to Vet Paula for the care and compassion she gives my dogs Pixie and Bailey and thanks to Alex for her continued help and support
I highly recommend Village Vets.
Thank you Elena!
Always brilliant with our two cats. The pet plan gives great peace of mind too.

Everyone at Village Vet Beaumont is wonderful.
Indie our beagle loves going in for his appointments, and is always made a fuss over.
The pet plan also means his check ups and vaccinations are covered, so I never have to worry about bringing him in. It's a peace of mind to know he is in the best hands.

Village Vets in Beaumont always provides excellent care. They are always gentle and kind with our dog and do everything in their power to make sure the animals they look after are happy and healthy. Their expert knowledge and hard work is invaluable!
Such nice people. Highly recommend. Great advice, especially for new owners of pets
Great vets, lovely atmosphere and there eo kind and patient with both animals and humans 😀 …
Good care, the doctor's diagnosis was more than accurate and helped us a lot.

Village Vets provides solid, reliable care for my dogs. The staff is efficient, knowledgeable, and straightforward with their advice. They don’t push unnecessary treatments and explain things clearly. The clinic is clean, and appointments run on time. Highly recommended!
Dear Claudine, Thank you so much for a 5 star review. We loved having Teddy  in with us yesterday! He is the best boy!
Hi Hiago, Thank  you so much for your 5 star review. We really appreciate it!
